highlights: War Week X marked 10 years of War Week, with a Survivor theme.
Three tribes competed: Red - Steady, Blue - Consistent and Yellow - Pressure.

The week culminated Friday in Ultimate Survivor, an individual elimination tournament for cash prizes, with immunity earned through daily puzzles, key events and the Tuesday Tribal Immunity Challenge.
Members of the tribe that won the Tribal Immunity Challenge automatically advanced to the second round of Ultimate Survivor.
The Centurion and Four Score Clubs were dropped this year to make War Week hours about quality over quantity.
Hosted the 8th annual Settlers of Catan tournament.
